_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/triggers/test_trigger_filter_owner.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_page_keeper` is Tome of Legends' trigger pair, written as the card writes it; `t_page_keeper_by_control` is the near miss -- the same triggers with `controller: "you"` in the filter instead of `owner: "you"` -- so the difference between the two readings is visible on one board.

cards.name: Test Page Keeper

Whenever your commander attacks, put a page counter on this artifact.
